parameters.content:
## AI Asset Analysis (Sub-workflow)
Called once per ambiguous version cluster from the main workflow's
"AI Asset Analysis — Per Cluster" node (Execute Workflow, per-item mode).

Native n8n HTTP Request + hand-rolled JSON Schema validation + one retry.
No LangChain / AI Agent node -- see docs/architecture-decision.md §4
for why a plain HTTP Request node was chosen over n8n's built-in
Structured Output Parser.

Known simplification: only ONE representative image per cluster is
sent to the vision model (not every member) to keep this canvas static
and legible. The retry path is text-only. Both are documented in
n8n/README.md → "Known simplifications".
